Mind powerful cheez hai.
Motivation shuru karati hai. Habit tikaye rakhti hai.
Woh badlaav khud baniye jo aap duniya mein dekhna chahte hain.
Only failure—try na karna.
"Fail se mat daro—try na karne se daro."
Kuch nahi badlega agar kuch nahi badlogey.
Motivation andar se aati hai.
Tum apne goals ke level tak nahi uthte; tum apne systems ke level tak girte ho.
Jo shot nahi lete, unka 100% chance chook jate ho.
Main taiyari karunga aur ek din mera avsar zaroor aayega.
